the probability of derailment due to crosswind forces on the two vehicles considered in this study is low, even for the higher mean wind speeds and gusts considered.

the wind loads calculated by the method presented in this paper do not result in any derailment of the passenger or freight vehicles considered for the wind speeds up to 20m/s.
the integration of crosswind loads into a vehicle dynamics simulation is a useful tool in predicting the effect of wind on the dynamic behaviour of a train.

the method we have developed for calculating wind forces on trains is fast and efficient enough to allow the wind forces to applied to detailed train dynamic modelling for long lengths of track.
